name: Rooftops
blurb: A cluster of city rooftops joined by ladders, planks and walkways above the streets: the area around the author's spawn.
author: youmenow1
attribution: Converted from ttt_rooftops_2016, https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=534491717 by youmenow1. Drawn from the map's own geometry with free (CC0) textures and stand-in models, listed in its world pack's credits; the author's textures and models are not carried. The author can have this conversion removed: contact https://github.com/zees-games/playlot-maps/issues.
